name_reason: Follows convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=15_end. The '15' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30), not a Ghidra address residue (function lives at 0x239bd). Name accurately reflects role as the chapter-15 end handler.
purpose: Chapter 15 (拉卡湖的激戰) end handler: shows the chapter-end dialog (page conditional on whether 凱麗 is in the party), persists the party's runtime-character state, recruits char #15 (賽可邦勒), and advances the current-chapter id.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x28) stack-check prologue, then page = (fd2_check_party_has_char_id(0xC) ^ 1) + 0xC -> page 12 when 凱麗 (char #0xC) present (returns 1), page 13 when absent (returns 0). Calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page, 0xa0000, 0x140, 0xcd, 0x4c, 0x4a, 0x13, 1), then fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template(). In the binary it ends with PUSH 0xF; JMP 0x237c8 (shared tail of fd2_chapter_11_end): fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0xF) recruits char #15 (賽可邦勒), then JMP 0x231f2 does INC current_chapter_id; RET. Source emits this self-contained (Layer 2 functional equivalence; jump-into-middle sharing not preserved).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: shows dialog, saves party template, recruits char #15, increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id.

reads_globals: data_fd2_current_chapter_text (passed to dialog scene as the chapter text pointer; loaded via PUSH dword [0x53a79])
data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id (read for the INC at the shared tail)
writes_globals: data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id (incremented by 1 at the shared tail, advancing to the next chapter)
